stage0.claim: The SAGE foundation exists and enforces its own rules: workspace builds, contract protocols are real and tested, hooks fire, gates run, memory is seeded, CI is green, dashboard renders

finite.response.reciprocity.claim: reciprocity_defect reads 0 on exact potential games and rises with harmonic fraction

dynamics.exact.claim: Glauber-logit dynamics are Gibbs-reversible exactly on potential games (pi = e^{lambda Phi}/Z, J* = 0, EPR = 0) and settle into a dissipative NESS off potentiality, with dissipation co-moving with harmonic fraction and reciprocity defect

solve.advanced.claim: Mirror descent, damped iteration and Gambit's homotopy agree on the QRE; implicit differentiation through the fixed point reproduces the Result 1 resolvent exactly

domains.blotto.claim: Blotto is a five-object plugin on Engine 1 with budgets as a live conjugate field; the instruments read high alpha, positive reciprocity defect and positive dissipation on non-degenerate instances, and exact zero on the degenerate constant-payoff instance

population.core.claim: Engine 2 exists and is exact: Fisk SUE solves the Beckmann-entropy convex program (KKT to 1e-10), the Beckmann gradient IS the route cost (autodiff, 1e-12), DF is symmetric for separable BPR costs, and toll susceptibility matches finite differences with zero reciprocity defect

domains.congestion.claim: Congestion is a five-object plugin on Engine 2 with link tolls as an exactly linear conjugate field; on real Sioux Falls data the meters read their theoretical values: R = 0, DF symmetric, Fisk KKT satisfied

science.phase_map.claim: The (lambda, alpha) phase surface is measured: the alpha=0 row reads zero on R and EPR at every lambda (calibration holds across the map); the MEDIAN game first crosses rho=1 at alpha=0.5; separately, a 0.2 fraction of individual games crosses at alpha=0.4; the frontier descends in alpha; on potential games rho(SB) is non-monotone in lambda (criticality escape via equilibrium concentration, F-0006). R inside the supercritical wedge is direction-only (near-singular resolvent)

solve.branch.claim: Pseudo-arclength continuation traces the principal QRE branch from the centroid through criticality: it passes through the fixed-lambda solver's points to 1e-7, matches Gambit's homotopy along the branch, and continues through rho = 1 (coordination pitchfork) without stalling

science.decoupling.claim: Measured on the chain_comovement families (paired design): R's within-level variation at alpha=0.95 is denominator-driven (rho(R, 1/den) = 0.993); the numerator ||chi - chi^T|| also loses its EPR coupling there (rho = -0.37, 95% CI excluding 0), refuting the corrected-meter hypothesis that was proposed post-hoc to explain F-0004; coupling holds (rho >= 0.55) for alpha <= 0.65 at lambda = 1.2 on 3x3 two-player families. The 'distinct mathematical objects' reading (local fixed-point derivative vs joint-chain flux functional) is interpretation - argued, not proved

api.core.claim: The instruments are servable: every reading (solve, decompose, response, dynamics, branch) is available over HTTP with provenance and honesty warnings attached, size-guarded, and reads identical values to the library on calibration-known games

web.scaffold.claim: SAGE Labs exists as a buildable Next.js app: Learn renders the single-source docs/theory explainers (three authored: softmax/lambda, reciprocity, the one-price objection stated honestly); the Lab reads all three meters live from the API with a lambda slider and the reproduce-in-Python funnel; next build passes with 9 static pages

thermo.estimators.claim: Irreversibility is estimable from trajectories alone: the KLD k-th order Markov estimator recovers the exact Schnakenberg EPR on synthetic Glauber data, and the TUR bound is a certified lower bound that degrades gracefully, tight near equilibrium and loosening toward harmonic games

estimate.lambda.claim: lambda is estimable four structurally different ways (frequency MLE, autodiff MLE, chi moment-matching, dispersion inversion), the family agrees on well-specified data, and its disagreement -- plus explicit unidentifiability warnings -- is a working misspecification diagnostic rather than a number that lies

domains.electricity.claim: Real market price series flow into the gated irreversibility estimators through an honest pipeline (coverage-guarded CAISO loader, discretization whose loop-blindness is proven and controlled, (price, delta-sign) phase embedding, FT AND amplitude-adjusted surrogate nulls with a below-band honesty flag). First readings, scoped to n<=4032 / 6 bins / this embedding: DAM hourly at-null (consistent with a linear time-reversible process); RTM 5-min NO DETECTION with the null-mismatch flag raised (the linear+marginal surrogate class cannot bracket its delta-sign persistence) — finding F-0008 as revised

science.frontier.claim: F-0006's and F-0004's open questions are resolved by sweep: the alpha=0 criticality peak is a pure lambda-x-payoff-scale fold (exact identity, verified numerically); the supercritical frontier lambda_c(alpha) is a clean monotone-descending curve (7.8 at alpha=0.55 to 3.0 at 0.80, no crossing below alpha~0.5 by lambda=15 at this sampling); and F-0004's reversal decomposes into a UNIVERSAL coupling collapse at alpha=0.95 plus a lambda-amplified sign flip (F-0010 — the pre-registered reversal criterion failed 2/4 and the failure is the finding)

domains.pricing.claim: The reciprocity meter's first empirical measurement: from the PI's HF Dominick's panel (gap-tolerant brand-level indices, two-way demeaning, cluster bootstrap over 86 stores), cross-brand cost pass-through is near-perfectly reciprocal (R = 0.0011 [0.0001, 0.005], asymmetry CI covering zero) — confirming the ex-ante single-retailer prediction stated in config before the run; and 30 stores' weekly category price indices are at-null for Edgeworth irreversibility (0/30 vs 0.3 expected false positives, conservative under subsample gaps)

thermo.protocols.claim: Exact housekeeping/excess decomposition and quench fluctuation theorems for the Glauber chain: sigma_tot = sigma_hk + sigma_ex with sigma_hk = 0 iff detailed balance and sigma_ex = -dD(p||pi)/dt; the Hatano-Sasa IFT <e^{-Y}> = 1 verified by the POWERED sampled-path check at alpha=0.5 (the exact transfer telescopes and is an identity verification only); the quench scan (predictions written in config before the run; the intended prior commit aborted — recorded) finds the driving-cost inversion (F-0012): excess collapses with alpha while housekeeping grows to 12.4 nats at a constant per-hold burn rate; the collapse's mechanism is OPEN

estimate.bayes.claim: Bayesian layer per ADR-0012: grid posterior over lambda with calibrated 95% coverage and a self-diagnosing grid-resolution guard; the F-0006 scale fold holds as an exact posterior reparameterisation; R1's mixture misspecification re-expressed as Bayes factors (decisive on mixture data, Occam-suppressed on clean); and an EFE/BALD experiment-selection loop whose first campaign adjudicates F-0012's open mechanism among four pre-declared quantitative hypotheses with an absolute adequacy guard and sigma-sensitivity re-run

product.toolkit.claim: strataq serves real users with their own data: strataq.toolkit answers the three headline questions (rationality posterior from choice counts, reciprocity verdict from any cross-response matrix, irreversibility verdict from any scalar series) in one call each from plain lists/numpy, every result carrying its honesty warnings; the decisive reversibilized-Markov null is promoted from experiment code into the library (strataq.thermo.nulls); README quickstart + tag-triggered PyPI trusted-publishing release workflow ship the package

science.quench_regimes.claim: Fast-quench dissipation is bracketed by the Fisher path-length floor (tau->inf) and the frozen divergence D(pi_start||pi_end) — exact AT tau=0 with a NON-UNIFORM approach (loop-like NESS paths break it; the alpha=0.95, lam_end=6 case fails the interpolation by ~1 dex and is reported, not averaged away). On monotone paths the single-gap crossover holds: held-out median 0.089 dex over 24 probes (max 0.46 at the tau=0.3 band); consumed max 1.06 dex on record. Run-1 winner_failed_validation is recorded and produced the min_probes STOPPING gate (the held-out guard stays the validator)

science.quench_multimode.claim: The per-step single-gap recursion supersedes the global crossover on a grid that now includes 3x3 games: grid median 0.076 dex, worst 0.44 (at alpha=0, tau=0.3 — a different cell from the incumbent's 1.11 at alpha>=0.5 long ramps; loop-path improvement +0.67 dex), held-out validated, full per-hypothesis accounting. Two-mode: run-1 anti-result RETRACTED as an implementation artifact; the corrected implementation still loses to one mode — the recorded lesson is about truncating the fast remainder, not non-normality

thermo.hs_estimator.claim: CERTIFIED within validated scope after a WITHHELD-then-GRANTED arc (F-0016): Hatano-Sasa Y from observed quench trajectories — plug-in with the mandatory pre-quench window, calibrated trajectory-bootstrap CI (20/20 at nominal 95%), primary relaxation gate (hold >= 4 x (lag-N/4 tau_hat + 2 SE), zero flicker at settled holds, conservative-only at margins, correct on the alpha=0 basin-hopping family with no game tuning), and a TESTED IFT anomaly companion that fires on genuinely non-stepwise input. v2 criteria C1-C5 all pass on a registration whose commit landed pre-run; scope and unit contracts explicit in the docstring

domains.electricity.quench.claim: THIRD revision after two red-team rounds (both overturned the headline; the arc is in F-0017). The unit claims exactly one in-scope number and one negative result: (1) the closed daily-loop affinity of 211 CAISO DAM day-pairs, Y_loop ~ 7.0 nats/day with day-block bootstrap [6.22, 8.50] — DESCRIPTIVE only (6 states extends rather than inherits the 4-state certification; the IFT companion cannot constrain a closed cycle); (2) the monthly scan supports NO causal statement — a seeded shuffle control (permanent artifact metric) attributes 0/7 months to temporal drift, and one month s anomaly flag FLIPS under a physically-null permutation, so monthly reads at n~30 are sampling noise. The earlier drift diagnosis is retracted; answering the premise needs small-n certification or coarser windows
